policy: Only byte-validated D1 ROI classes and type/subtype identities are named. Export routes describe currently implemented decoding stages; they do not imply semantic ownership or complete visual fidelity.

80800734.label: s_entity
80800734.notes: Entity root. Requires serialized child/EntityResource relationships before a composed visual export can be claimed.

80800861.label: EntityResource
80800861.notes: Generic EntityResource wrapper; inner class pair determines role.

80801AB5.label: s_entity_model
80801AB5.notes: Geometry can be exported in isolation. Correct visible-range, material, skin, owner, and placement selection remain separate evidence layers.

80801AD7.label: SMaterial_ROI_PS4
80801AD7.notes: PS4 D1 ROI material. Shader/texture arrays can be decoded; portable rendering requires shader-role translation.

808005A1.label: s_animation_clip
808005A1.notes: Clip payload can be decoded, but final skeletal animation requires a proven compatible runtime rig and skeleton/owner path.

80802C0E.label: animation_action_control
80802C0E.notes: D1 ROI action/state selector table. FileHash animation lists, StringHash states, packed selectors and empty sentinel are source-closed; semantic ownership remains a separate graph edge.

8080222A.label: animation_control_wrapper
8080222A.notes: Structured animation/control wrapper; preserved until owner/selector semantics are fully generalized.

808008B2.label: runtime_rig_payload
808008B2.notes: Runtime-rig role/component semantics are proven; some surrounding schema fields remain partial.

8080049A.label: skeleton_hierarchy_transforms
8080049A.notes: Validated skeleton hierarchy/default/inverse transform payload role.

808003F6.label: SF603_activity_entity_resource_carrier
808003F6.notes: Source-pinned Activity carrier. +0x0C resolves an EntityResource; supported inner forms collapse to serialized SMapDataEntry rows. This route preserves activity ownership and requires surrounding Activity context.

808009A2.label: SMapDataTable
808009A2.notes: Pinned D1 SMapDataTable. +0x08 is DynamicArray<SMapDataEntry> with exact 0x90-byte rows. Placement meaning remains tied to world/activity ownership.

808012D9.label: SD912_scripted_entity_table
808012D9.notes: Pinned D1 SD912 scripted-entity table. Script-family/type StringHashes, SMapDataEntry-backed entity records, and locations are decoded only in activity ownership context; table presence alone does not establish actor identity.

808091E0.label: SBubbleDefinition
808091E0.notes: Pinned D1 Bubble root. +0x08 contains SMapContainer tags; Activity ownership is authoritative for world selection.

80808A54.label: SMapContainer
80808A54.notes: Pinned D1 map container. +0x18 contains SMapDataTable tags.

80801AEA.label: SMapDataResource
80801AEA.notes: Pinned SMapDataEntry DataResource payload class. Exact +0x0C Tag/FileHash selects SStaticMapParent.

80801AC6.label: SStaticMapParent
80801AC6.notes: Pinned static-map parent. Exact +0x08 Tag/FileHash selects SStaticMapData.

808008B4.label: SStaticMapData
808008B4.notes: Pinned static-map data structure reached through the SMapDataResource -> SStaticMapParent ownership chain.

80801B75.label: SStaticMapData_D1
80801B75.notes: Current D1 static-map payload class used by the source-driven world pipeline. Generation-safe parsing is required; older 80801A90 payloads must never be silently substituted.

80801A90.label: static_table
80801A90.notes: Pinned static-table class with shipped mesh/info arrays. It is a distinct class from current 80801B75 static-map payloads and must not be used as a generation fallback for them.

32:1.label: texture_header
32:1.notes: D1 texture-header entry form accepted by the exact texture decoder.

32:2.label: texture_header
32:2.notes: D1 texture-header entry form accepted by the exact texture decoder.
